name: Nishina Haruta
source:
Haruta is the protagonist of the game. Having spent his youth with his [url=https://vndb.org/c77826]mother[/url] in Indonesia where she worked as an Indonesian-Japanese translator, he re-moved to Japan some time after the death of his mother or he was adopted by the Kamikawa family. At that time, the family was composed of [url=https://vndb.org/c77699]Michinori[/url], his [url=https://vndb.org/c77827]wife[/url], and [url=https://vndb.org/c55695]Saya[/url] ([url=https://vndb.org/c69312]Wakana[/url], who had already left the family home very early because she was in conflict and in total disagreement with her father).

During his childhood, he met [url=https://vndb.org/c62292]Miaya[/url], who soon became his closest friend. During this period of his life, his love feelings began to develop towards Saya. Their feelings came into concordance a year and a half ago or they started dating.

However, seeing their relationship change, Michinori had summoned Haruta and emancipated him, giving him the name of his mother and confessing a harsh truth to him: that he was his biological son and that Saya and he were brother and sister. He then kicked him out and Haruta started living alone in a small apartment near his high school. But that did not mean the beginning of a life of loneliness, because Miaya lives in an apartment near Haruta to take care of him, herself.
This is how the story of our hero begins...
